sources.title: Measuring Progress on Scalable Oversight for Large Language Models — quoted full-text passages (arXiv 2211.03540v2 PDF)

state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors describe an inner loop in which non-experts iteratively try to align the model until they are convinced it performs satisfactorily, after which experts compare the result with a model aligned under their own careful supervision; the outer loop repeats this while developing the oversight strategy and ends with a verdict on whether any scalable oversight strategy of the type being studied is sufficient to align the model on the task and, if not, how often it fails and how harmful its failures are likely to be.
title: Sandwiching agenda: inner loop (non-experts align) and outer loop (expert verdict)
